name: Valkyr Storm-Caller
loreTies: A battlefield psychopomp who calls storm pressure over oathbreakers and strengthens sworn allies during faction clashes.
Buffs melee units and marks exposed Deity routes.
source culture humans later copied as Norse myth
shortBackstory: Valkyr Storm-Caller is a lore-faithful Asgardian run-in creature used when missions or events justify faction contact without rewriting the faction or creating playable squads.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Valkyr Storm-Caller belongs to The Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds and exists to express Asgardian law, pressure, or defense during Gate instability.

chapters.title: Faction Function
chapters.text: Buffs melee units and marks exposed Deity routes.

chapters.title: Lore Guardrail
chapters.text: Do not use as a generic monster; keep faction law, materials, motives, and silhouette intact.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: It may appear in enemy-controlled zones, border conflicts, Gate events, pursuits, trials, bargains, or defensive reactions when the mission gives a lore-valid reason.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Visuals must follow: Winged storm helm, rain-bright spear, dark feather mantle, aurora shield light. Abilities — Gale Mark, Oath Mend, Raven Sight — must telegraph clearly for mobile one-Deity-vs-many combat.

developmentStatus: Readable faction run-in creature profile integrated into mission/event encounter pools.
